note: HOF molecolari di una gabbia organica flessibile con ponti di ossigeno (Cage-6-COOH): CageHOF-2α (3 reti interpenetrate, non porosa), CageHOF-2β (2 reti, porosa) e cinque solvati; sette strutture SCXRD in totale. Dati cristallografici nel testo solo per α e β; per i solvati (DMAc, DESO, NMP, THF, H2O) le tabelle S6–S10 sono nel supplementare e il testo non da' CCDC. «CageHOF-2» è usato dagli autori sia per il solido a bassa cristallinità (attivato) sia come prefisso della famiglia dei solvati («CageHOF-2·THF»): qui F4 è il solido a bassa cristallinità. Le isoterme di sorbimento (CH3CN, EtOH, CO2, N2) sono eventi quando il testo dice che la fase cambia (PXRD); il sorbimento senza cambio di fase (N2 a 77 K su β) è un negativo. Il testo non da' le temperature del VT-PXRD di α (Fig. S11, S12, S15) né la velocità. Incoerenze del testo: (1) Introduzione: «CageHOF-2α switches to CageHOF-2β in response to ethanol vapor», Risultati: è la polvere attivata CageHOF-2 (collassata) che diventa β con vapore di EtOH (ad α non e' mai applicato l'EtOH); (2) area superficiale di β: abstract e fine della sezione sorbimento 458 m2 g–1, sezione 'Properties' 410 m2 g–1 (campione attivato per scambio di solvente e vuoto; 458 dalla preparazione scalata con vapore di EtOH); (3) la cella di β da SCXRD (a 43.576(4) Å, V 8275.5(11) Å3) e da Pawley sul campione solvatato (a 44.06 Å, V 8374.5 Å3) differiscono; (4) «an activated, solvent-free, activated CageHOF-2 powder» (ripetizione); (5) abstract: «a remarkable 67° dihedral angle range» (90°–157°) mentre i singoli intervalli sono 116°–126° (α) e 90°–143° (β); (6) lo scambio di solvente di β e' fatto con EtOH → acetone → n-pentano, ma dopo l'attivazione resta «a trace amount of EtOH solvent (3.5 wt %)».

motivi_hb.motivo: carboxylic acid dimers (3-D HOF, acs topology, 3-fold interpenetrated)
motivi_hb.chi: Cage-6-COOH with six neighbouring Cage-6-COOH molecules
motivi_hb.citazione: In the extended CageHOF-2α structure, each Cage-6-COOH hydrogen bonds to six neighboring Cage-6-COOH molecules via strongly directional carboxylic acid dimers at donor–acceptor distances in the range of 2.58–2.59 Å.

forme.citazione: Single-crystal X-ray diffraction (SCXRD) analysis revealed that Cage-6-COOH crystallized from the THF/CH3CN solution in the hexagonal space group P6̅2c (a = 22.6444(8) Å, c = 16.4319(5) Å, V = 7296.9(6) Å3).
forme.note: Cristallo SCXRD da THF/CH3CN; il campione in massa e' «the CH3CN-solvated crystalline sample» (PXRD, Pawley). Stechiometria dell'ospite non detta; pori da 2.2 nm riempiti di solvente e tre piccoli pori triangolari (<10 Å). Meta' molecola nell'unita' asimmetrica; non porosa dopo attivazione. Angoli diedri dei pilastri 116°–126°.

motivi_hb.motivo: carboxylic acid dimers, not all planar (3-D HOF, distorted acs topology, 2-fold interpenetrated)
motivi_hb.chi: Cage-6-COOH with six neighbouring Cage-6-COOH molecules
motivi_hb.citazione: In CageHOF-2β, each Cage-6-COOH molecule in the structure hydrogen bonds with six neighboring Cage-6-COOH molecules via carboxylic acid dimers at donor–acceptor distances in the range of 2.51–2.74 Å.
However, unlike those in CageHOF-2α, the hydrogen-bond motifs in CageHOF-2β are not all planar, and the aromatic pillars have profoundly different orientations.

forme.citazione: As shown in Figure 3, the CageHOF-2β structure, which has orthorhombic P21212 symmetry (a = 43.576(4) Å, b = 11.7207(9) Å, c = 16.2030(8) Å, and V = 8275.5(11) Å3), contains two pores with different sizes and shapes.

citazioni: However, all attempts to remove the solvent from the crystal pores, including heating (Figures S11 and S12) and supercritical CO2 drying (scCO2, Figure S13), caused CageHOF-2α to transform into a low-crystallinity solid (referred to as CageHOF-2) that was nonporous based on N2 sorption at 77 K (Figure S14).

We used variable-temperature (VT) PXRD measurement to monitor the desolvation of the CH3CN-solvated CageHOF-2α sample. During the VT-PXRD study, we observed a contraction along the a = b unit cell axes while heating the sample to remove the solvent from the crystal pores. Over the same range, the structure appeared to remain unchanged along the c unit cell axis (Figure S15), which we attribute to the denser packing of Cage-6-COOH layers in the CageHOF-2α crystal structure (Figure S16).

eventi.note: Rimozione del solvente (CH3CN) da CageHOF-2α per riscaldamento: il solido collassa in un solido a bassa cristallinita' non poroso (CageHOF-2). Durante il VT-PXRD la cella si contrae lungo a = b e resta invariata lungo c (impacchettamento denso degli strati). Frase unica per piu' tentativi («all attempts ... including heating and supercritical CO2 drying»): un evento per tentativo, certezza media.

citazioni: No significant changes were observed in the VT-PXRD patterns of CageHOF-2β while increasing the temperature from 303 to 433 K or upon recooling the sample to room temperature, indicating that CageHOF-2β has good thermal stability (Figure S18).
From the VT-PXRD study, we also observed that CageHOF-2β contracts along the a and b unit cell axes during heating while expanding along the c unit cell axis (Figure S20).

gruppi_coinvolti.citazione: We attribute this to the hydrogen-bonding interactions between Cage-6-COOH molecules reorganizing into a more planar geometry along the c unit cell axis, which enables the Cage-6-COOH molecules to pack more closely along the a and b unit cell axes (Figure S21).

eventi.note: Nessun cambiamento significativo da 303 a 433 K e al ritorno a temperatura ambiente; solo variazione anisotropa della cella (a e b si contraggono, c si espande). Il campione non e' precisato (solvatato o attivato): e' prima dell'attivazione («This thermal stability encouraged us to obtain crystalline porous materials by careful desolvation treatment»), quindi da = β solvatata (da_dedotto).

citazioni: Before studying the porosity of CageHOF-2β, we first exchanged the EtOH crystallization solvent with acetone and then n-pentane over 2 days, noting that n-pentane is the most volatile and least likely to interact strongly with the pore walls (see SI Section 4 for details). Then, we activated the pores under a dynamic vacuum at room temperature.
Unlike CageHOF-2α, the crystallinity of CageHOF-2β appeared to be preserved after activating the crystal, according to the PXRD patterns (Figure 3e and Figure S22).
However, the NMR spectrum indicates that the activated CageHOF-2β still contained a trace amount of EtOH solvent (3.5 wt %, Figure S23).
Thermogravimetric analysis (TGA, Figure S24) showed a 5% weight loss before 450 °C, in broad agreement with the NMR data.
eventi.pretrattamento: scambio del solvente di cristallizzazione: EtOH → acetone → n-pentano in 2 giorni
eventi.note: Attivazione di CageHOF-2β: dopo lo scambio di solvente (EtOH → acetone → n-pentano, 2 giorni) il vuoto dinamico a temperatura ambiente toglie il solvente e la cristallinita' resta (PXRD), a differenza di α. Residuo di EtOH 3.5 wt % (NMR) e TGA 5% prima di 450 °C. Il prodotto (F3) e' poroso (SA_BET 410 m2 g–1, isoterma N2 di tipo I). La durata del vuoto non e' detta.

citazioni: Next, we recorded an N2 sorption isotherm for the activated CageHOF-2β at 77 K.
We also recorded a PXRD pattern of CageHOF-2β after the N2 sorption isotherm, which confirmed the good stability of CageHOF-2β during this sorption measurement (Figure S26).
eventi.note: Dopo l'isoterma di N2 a 77 K su β attivata il PXRD conferma la stabilita' della struttura durante il sorbimento.

citazioni: To do this, we conducted organic vapor sorption experiments by exposing an activated, solvent-free, activated CageHOF-2 powder to CH3CN vapor.

In the CH3CN sorption isotherm, we observed a stepwise increase in the uptake (Figure 5a) with a gradual increase over the low-pressure range, followed by a steep increase in the uptake at P/P0 = 0.43.
PXRD patterns recorded after CH3CN vapor exposure indicated that the CageHOF-2 powder had switched to CageHOF-2α with high crystallinity.
Organic vapor sorption isotherms of activated Cage-HOF-2 at 298 K.

The flexibility of Cage-6-COOH allows this molecule to rapidly transform from a low-crystallinity solid into the two crystalline interpenetrated HOFs, CageHOF-2α and CageHOF-2β, under mild conditions simply by using acetonitrile or ethanol vapor, respectively.

eventi.note: Autoguarigione (self-healing): la polvere attivata a bassa cristallinita' torna ad α con alta cristallinita' con vapore di CH3CN a 298 K; salto netto dell'assorbimento a P/P0 = 0.43, saturazione verso 0.85. Volumi di pori: 0.12 cm3 g–1 a P/P0 = 0.41, 0.23 a 0.68, 0.25 a 0.93 (sotto il valore teorico di α, 0.40 cm3 g–1). I dimeri dell'acido carbossilico sono il sintone di α (struttura SCXRD); il testo non dice se si formino o si ricompongano nella trasformazione.

citazioni: Further PXRD experiments suggested that this transformation was reversible; that is, the regenerated CageHOF-2α crystal transformed to CageHOF-2 powder again after removing the CH3CN (Figures S40–S42).
eventi.note: Ritorno ad CageHOF-2 a bassa cristallinita' togliendo il CH3CN: il testo non dice come (T, vuoto, tempo) ne' quanto: «suggested». Il degassaggio a 333 K per 12 h e' descritto per il campione prima dell'isoterma di EtOH (E8), non per questo ritorno.

citazioni: After the CH3CN vapor sorption isotherm, we used the same sample for an EtOH vapor sorption isotherm after degassing the material at 333 K for 12 h. Again, we observed a gate-opening-type sorption isotherm, with a sharp increase occurring from about P/P0 = 0.35, indicating the existence of a phase transformation (Figure 5b).
A further PXRD study confirmed that activated CageHOF-2 powder transformed into the porous CageHOF-2β phase upon treatment with EtOH vapor (Figure S41).
In this case, the sorption process was irreversible until the fourth cycle.

citazioni: We first crystallized Cage-6-COOH from tetrahydrofuran (THF) after carefully layering acetonitrile (CH3CN) on the THF solution (see the SI, Section 4 for full details). After leaving the crystallization undisturbed at room temperature for 5 days, we observed colorless needle-like crystals that were suitable for X-ray analysis (Figures S6 and S7).

Next, we expanded our crystallization screen and discovered a new polymorph, CageHOF-2β, that was formed by crystallizing Cage-6-COOH from ethanol (EtOH) after leaving a solution to evaporate at 343 K. During the crystallization, we observed spindle-like crystals on the surface of the vial (Figure S8).

proprieta.citazione: However, the energy required to rotate the pillars of Cage-6-COOH by 60° from 120° was approximately 6.4 kcal mol–1 (Figure S38 and Section 1.2.7 for full details), which is within the usual energetic range of polymorphism.49

descrizioni.testo: rotazione a cerniera dei tre pilastri aromatici attorno ai ponti di ossigeno; angolo diedro Φ da 90° in CageHOF-2β fino a 157° in CageHOF-2·H2O; i tre pilastri sono flessibili in modo indipendente
descrizioni.citazione: Indeed, we found that the dihedral angle (Φ in Figure 4) could rotate from 90° in CageHOF-2β to up to 157° in CageHOF-2·H2O.

descrizioni.citazione: For comparison, the dihedral angles in CageHOF-2α range between 116° and 126°, while the dihedral angles in CageHOF-2β range between 90° and 143°.

descrizioni.testo: simmetria D3h in soluzione (due singoletti aromatici a δ = 8.78 e 6.76 ppm)
descrizioni.citazione: We also observed two singlets at δ = 8.78 and 6.76 ppm, assigned to the two aromatic protons, indicating that Cage-6-COOH adopts a high D3h-symmetric structure in solution.
